rust_summary: An entity's hit about to be checked for blocking (`native_living_shield_block`).
doc_summary: Any hit with damage on a player, mob or the ender dragon, raised item or not, as `LivingEntity.applyItemBlocking` is about to resolve the block: `native_living_shield_block(entity, kind, source, damage, original_blocked, block, canceled)` may change `block` (`blocked`, `blocked_damage`, `shield_damage`) or set `canceled` so nothing is blocked. A `shield_damage` below 0 applies the item's own `itemDamage` to what is stopped. Only a player raises a blocking item, so `original_blocked` is false for the others. Bundles need "hooks": @API:living_shield_block@.
